types.title: Client
types.description: Generates requests at random times at the configured average rate. Each request has an overall deadline.
assumptions: New requests arrive at random times at the configured average rate, independently of earlier completions. Each request has an overall deadline measured from arrival.
After the deadline the client stops waiting, but admitted work continues.

params.name: load
params.title: Load profile
params.description: Average request arrival rate over time, including warm-up; it changes linearly between points. Compare profiles in variants. Initially one point at 0s with 10/s.

fields.name: points
fields.title: Load points
fields.description: Increasing times with linear interpolation; the nearest rate is held outside the points.

fields.name: time
fields.title: Time
fields.description: Time from simulation start, including warm-up.

fields.name: rate
fields.title: Intensity
fields.description: Non-negative average request arrival rate.

params.name: classes
params.title: Request classes
params.description: Per-class load profiles; use either load or classes. Variants replace the entire list; grids are not supported.

fields.name: id
fields.title: Class id
fields.description: Unique block-style identifier; default is reserved.

types.title: Service
types.description: A replica holds a handler while processing a request, waiting for downstream calls and pausing before retries.
assumptions: A handler is allocated once and held through local processing, all downstream attempts, and backoff; retries do not re-enter the caller queue.
An upstream timeout or deadline does not release downstream handlers or remove admitted work.

params.name: handlers
params.title: Handlers
params.description: Maximum requests handled at once by each replica, similar to threads, workers or a concurrency limit. A handler stays occupied while waiting for downstream calls and retries. Initially 200.

params.name: queue
params.title: Queue capacity
params.description: Waiting places in the FIFO queue. 0 means no queue: when all handlers are busy, an attempt is rejected immediately. Initially 100.

params.name: processing
params.title: Processing time
params.description: Local processing time of one attempt. Initially exponential with a mean of 10ms.

fields.name: kind
fields.title: Distribution
fields.description: Choose fixed for a constant duration, exponential for independent random durations, or lognormal for a long tail of slow operations.

fields.name: mean
fields.title: Mean
fields.description: Use the measured average, not p95 or p99. It sets the scale of the chosen distribution.

fields.name: stdDev
fields.title: Standard deviation
fields.description: For lognormal only: use the measured standard deviation. Larger values produce more variation.

params.name: failureRate
params.title: Failure rate
params.description: Probability that one local attempt fails.

params.name: replicas
params.title: Replicas
params.description: Number of service instances. More replicas distribute incoming requests across independent handler pools.

params.name: rateLimit
params.title: Rate limit
params.description: Per-instance token bucket before the handler queue. Rejections occupy no handler; probes bypass the bucket.

fields.name: rate
fields.title: Token rate
fields.description: Tokens replenished per second, up to the burst capacity. Zero permits only the initial burst.

fields.name: burst
fields.title: Burst capacity
fields.description: Maximum tokens; the bucket starts full at each replication.

params.name: healthCheck
params.title: Readiness check
params.description: Probes share the handler queue and processing capacity. All routers skip an instance while it is not ready.

fields.name: interval
fields.title: Probe interval
fields.description: Minimum time between probe starts; the first probe starts after this interval.

fields.name: timeout
fields.title: Probe timeout
fields.description: Maximum wait for a probe result, including queueing. Admitted processing continues after timeout.

fields.name: unhealthyThreshold
fields.title: Unhealthy threshold
fields.description: Consecutive failed probes required to mark the initially ready instance not ready.

fields.name: healthyThreshold
fields.title: Healthy threshold
fields.description: Consecutive successful probes required to restore readiness.

fields.name: processing
fields.title: Probe processing time
fields.description: Local handler time, affected by processing delay faults, without running the request scenario or network.

types.title: Request
types.description: Delivers original requests from the client to the entry service without delay or retries.
assumptions: Client requests enter the first service without network delay, per-attempt timeout, or retries.

outputs.title: Attempts per call
outputs.description: Sent attempts divided by first attempts (sent attempts minus retries); no value without first attempts.

overlay.title: Attempts per call
overlay.label: Attempts per call {value}
overlay.description: Sent attempts / first attempts, pooled across replications.
overlay.windowDescription: Sent attempts / first attempts in this window; no value without first attempts.

outputs.title: Attempts per original request
outputs.description: Attempts admitted by the destination per original client request. Request-type routing and load balancing can make this less than 1.

overlay.title: Attempts per original request
overlay.label: Attempts per original request {value}
overlay.description: Attempts admitted by the destination per original request, averaged across replications. Request-type routing and load balancing can make this less than 1.
overlay.windowDescription: Window approximation: admitted attempts / original client arrivals; attempts may belong to earlier requests. Request-type routing and load balancing can make this less than 1.

types.title: Call
types.description: Synchronous call with a per-attempt timeout, retries and backoff on the caller side.
assumptions: A timeout stops the caller from waiting; it does not cancel downstream work, which remains as orphaned work and continues consuming resources.
Late responses are discarded after timeout or deadline.
Cancellation does not propagate along the call chain.

params.name: network
params.title: Network delay
params.description: One-way network delay, drawn separately for the request and the response. Initially fixed at 1ms.

fields.name: kind
fields.title: Distribution
fields.description: Choose fixed for a constant duration, exponential for independent random durations, or lognormal for a long tail of slow operations.

fields.name: mean
fields.title: Mean
fields.description: Use the measured average, not p95 or p99. It sets the scale of the chosen distribution.

fields.name: stdDev
fields.title: Standard deviation
fields.description: For lognormal only: use the measured standard deviation. Larger values produce more variation.

params.name: timeout
params.title: Timeout
params.description: Per-attempt timeout, also bounded by the remaining deadline. Initially 1s.

params.name: attempts
params.title: Attempts
params.description: Maximum attempts including the first one.

params.name: balancing
params.title: Balancing
params.description: Choose how attempts are distributed across the target replicas. The default is round robin.

params.name: retryTarget
params.title: Retry target
params.description: Another replica prefers a replica or routing target not yet tried by this request; once all have been tried, any may be reused.

params.name: pool
params.title: Connection pool
params.description: Connections owned by each calling instance, held until a response or attempt timeout.

fields.name: size
fields.title: Pool size
fields.description: Maximum simultaneous connections for this call on each caller instance. Initially 10 when the pool is enabled.

fields.name: acquireTimeout
fields.title: Acquisition timeout
fields.description: Maximum wait for a free connection, also bounded by the remaining deadline. 0 means no waiting: if no connection is free, the attempt fails immediately.

params.name: backoff
params.title: Backoff
params.description: Pause before a retry (backoff). The calling handler remains occupied during the pause.

fields.name: kind
fields.title: Kind
fields.description: Fixed uses the base delay, capped by the maximum. Exponential pauses choose a random value from zero to the current limit; the multiplier sets how that limit changes.

fields.name: base
fields.title: Base delay
fields.description: Base pause after the first failed attempt; full jitter chooses a random pause between zero and the current limit.

fields.name: max
fields.title: Maximum delay
fields.description: Upper bound of one backoff delay.

fields.name: multiplier
fields.title: Multiplier
fields.description: Growth factor of exponential backoff.

params.name: circuitBreaker
params.title: Circuit breaker
params.description: An open circuit breaker rejects attempts locally. Each calling instance keeps its own window of completed attempts.

fields.name: failureRate
fields.title: Failure threshold
fields.description: Open when the failure share reaches this threshold after the minimum number of completed attempts.

fields.name: minimumCalls
fields.title: Minimum calls
fields.description: Completed attempts required before evaluating the failure share; no greater than the window size.

fields.name: window
fields.title: Window size
fields.description: Number of most recent completed attempts in the closed circuit breaker's window. Circuit breaker rejections are excluded.

fields.name: openDuration
fields.title: Open duration
fields.description: Time before allowing half-open probes; rejected attempts use no pool, network or target work.

fields.name: halfOpenCalls
fields.title: Half-open calls
fields.description: Maximum number of probe attempts. Their completed failure share decides whether to close or reopen.

params.name: retryBudget
params.title: Retry budget
params.description: Bound retries by a share of first attempts plus a minimum allowance over a rolling time window.

fields.name: ratio
fields.title: Retry ratio
fields.description: Maximum retries per first attempt within the window.

fields.name: minPerSecond
fields.title: Minimum retries per second
fields.description: Additional allowance multiplied by the window duration; it is available even with no first attempts.

fields.name: window
fields.title: Budget window
fields.description: Age after which first attempts and retries leave the budget.

params.name: fallback
params.title: Fallback
params.description: Replace a matching final call failure after all attempts. Successful originals with a fallback count as degraded.

fields.name: on
fields.title: Failure reasons
fields.description: Final failure reasons replaced by the fallback; deadline is excluded.

fields.name: processing
fields.title: Fallback processing time
fields.description: Time spent on the calling handler before continuing the scenario, bounded by the original deadline.

params.name: outlierDetection
params.title: Outlier detection
params.description: Temporarily excludes failing targets. State is shared by all callers of the router or replica group.

fields.name: consecutiveFailures
fields.title: Consecutive failures
fields.description: Target failures required for ejection; a successful attempt resets the streak.

fields.name: baseEjection
fields.title: Base ejection time
fields.description: Time excluded on the first ejection; multiplied by the target's ejection number thereafter.

fields.name: maxEjected
fields.title: Maximum ejected share
fields.description: Maximum fraction of distinct targets excluded at once, rounded down; at least one target remains.

types.title: Router
types.description: Selects a service, database or another router without queueing or delay; outputs are measured on route connections.
assumptions: Selection has no queue or delay; a new output is selected for each calling attempt.

params.name: policy
params.title: Policy
params.description: Round robin, weighted random, or fewest unfinished attempts; ties use route path order.

params.name: outlierDetection
params.title: Outlier detection
params.description: Temporarily excludes failing targets. State is shared by all callers of the router or replica group.

fields.title: Consecutive failures

fields.name: maxEjected

types.title: Route
types.description: One router output to a callable block.
assumptions: Output weight affects random selection only; timeout and retries belong to the incoming call.

types.title: Database
types.description: Database server with a connection limit and a bounded FIFO query queue; no outgoing calls.
assumptions: Each query holds one connection until completion; waiting queries use a bounded FIFO queue.
An upstream timeout does not cancel an admitted query or release its connection.

params.title: Query time
params.description: Execution time of one database query. Initially exponential with a mean of 5ms.

fields.title: Distribution
fields.description: Choose fixed for a constant duration, exponential for independent random durations, or lognormal for a long tail of slow operations.

fields.name: mean

fields.description: Use the measured average, not p95 or p99. It sets the scale of the chosen distribution.

fields.name: stdDev
fields.title: Standard deviation
fields.description: For lognormal only: use the measured standard deviation. Larger values produce more variation.

types.title: Transaction pooler
types.description: Client admission and a bounded-wait server connection pool before one synchronous call.
assumptions: Transaction mode: client connections have no queue; server connections use a FIFO wait timeout.
The server connection is held through local delay and the outgoing call; the client connection lasts through the reply.
An upstream timeout does not cancel admitted pooler work.

params.title: Server pool size

params.name: waitTimeout
params.title: Server connection wait timeout
params.description: Maximum FIFO wait for a server connection. 0 means no waiting: if no server connection is free, the attempt is rejected immediately. Initially 5s.

params.name: processing
params.title: Pooler delay
params.description: Local delay after acquiring a server connection, before the outgoing call. New poolers start with a fixed delay of 0.1ms; if omitted from a document, the delay is fixed at 0ms.

params.description: Entry lifetime unless its key space supplies another TTL.

params.title: TTL jitter
params.description: Uniform relative variation on either side of the TTL.

params.name: keySpaces
params.title: Key spaces

assumptions: Summary request and attempt metrics follow original requests arriving during measurement and all attempts they cause, including completion after measurement ends. Summary resource values cover only measurement.
Time series cover warm-up and measurement. Events belong to the windows when they occur; completion after measurement ends is excluded.
Latency percentiles, such as p95, are estimates from compact summaries of observations. Representation error is at most 0.78125% in the tested 0.001–60000 ms range.
A 95% confidence interval expresses uncertainty in the mean across independent replications, using Student's t method. Bounds are not clipped to physically possible values.
